title: Metroid Prime: The Phendrana Shorelines
alt: A cold shore under a grey sky, with snow falling. A figure in orange armour stands on a ledge of snow with her back to us. She has a red helmet, two great round shoulders and a thick green cannon on her right arm. Before her is a still dark lake with flat stones in it, each capped with snow. On the far shore stands a round stone tower under a dark roof with wide red eaves that curl up, a long hall with arches and a pale dome, and a smaller tower beyond. Warm lamps burn at the tower and in a dark crag at the left. Cliffs of blue ice stand behind, with a frozen fall of water. Footprints lead up the snow to the figure.
summary: A painting of Samus at the Phendrana Shorelines from Metroid Prime in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Phendrana Drifts, from Metroid Prime, by Retro Studios. Samus Aran comes up out of the caves of fire into the cold. The first thing that she sees is this shore, with the Ice Temple of the Chozo across the water.

The Chozo made the temple long ago and are gone, but their lamps still burn. Samus wears the Varia Suit, and her arm cannon is on her right arm. We see only her back. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
